data.title: The Empty Seat at the Cafe
data.excerpt: Every afternoon, she ordered two cups of coffee even though she had been sitting alone for three years.
content: Every afternoon at four, Mira walked into the same little cafe and chose the table beside the window.
She always ordered two cups of coffee.
The first was black, without sugar. The second had milk and one spoonful of sugar.
The second cup was never touched.
The barista had stopped asking about it a long time ago. He simply placed both cups on the table and walked away.
Three years earlier, someone had sat across from Mira and promised they would return after one last trip.
Still, Mira came back every afternoon.
One rainy evening, the barista finally sat down across from her.
"You don't have to keep doing this," he said.
Mira looked at the untouched cup.
"I know," she replied. "I just don't know what to do with the extra cup yet."
